title: Construction of the spectral sequence of a filtered complex
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex, and let $F^\bullet K^\bullet$ be a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Form the bigraded differential object $A^{p,q}=F^{p+1}K^{p+1+q}$, with differential induced by $d$, and let $\alpha:A\to A[-1,1]$ be the componentwise inclusion $F^{p+1}K^{p+1+q}\hookrightarrow F^pK^{p+1+q}$. The filtered-complex spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence] is the spectral sequence associated to this injective morphism of differential bigraded objects; its differential on page $r$ has bidegree $(r,1-r)$, and its initial graded object is $E_0^{p,q}=\operatorname{gr}^pK^{p+q}$ with differential induced by $d$.

source.place: Definition 12.18.1 and Remark 12.18.2 (differential-object self-map construction), used in the proof of Lemma 12.19.2, Tag 012K

proof.text: Construct the page-zero bigraded complex $P^{p,q}=(F.\mathrm{gradedPiece}\ p).X(p+q)$. For equal first coordinates use the differential of the graded complex, with the equality transport to its target; otherwise use zero. Its shape and square-zero identities follow from the corresponding identities of each graded complex. The component isomorphisms are identities and intertwine the differentials.
Choose the positive-page spectral sequence $E_1$ with its cycle/boundary quotient descriptions.

For each $(p,q)$, identify $H(P)^{p,q}$ with $Z_1^{p,q}/B_1^{p,q}$ using the page-zero homology lemma. Compose this isomorphism with the inverse of the chosen quotient identification of $(E_1.\mathrm{page}\ 1)^{p,q}$. The two inclusion proofs are proof-irrelevant, so the cokernel objects agree.

Define $E.\mathrm{page}\ 0=P$ and use the pages of $E_1$ at every $r\ge1$. At $r=0$ use the preceding homology isomorphism; at $r\ge1$ use the homology isomorphisms of $E_1$. Case analysis on $r=0$, using $r\ge0$ and $r+1=r^{\prime}$, checks the SpectralSequence fields. The identity page-zero identifications give the required differential equation, and the positive-page quotient descriptions are inherited from $E_1$.

lean.statement: theorem filteredComplex_associated_spectralSequence (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) : ∃ (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence C 0) (e : ∀ p q : ℤ, (E.page 0).X (p, q) ≅ (F.gradedPiece p).X (p + q)), (∀ p q : ℤ, (E.page 0).d (p, q) (p, q + 1) ≫ (e p (q + 1)).hom = (e p q).hom ≫ (F.gradedPiece p).d (p + q) (p + (q + 1))) ∧ ∀ (p q r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r), ∃ hBZ : F.complexBoundaries p (p + q) r ≤ F.complexCycles p (p + q) r, Nonempty ((E.page r).X (p, q) ≅ cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hBZ))
